correctness.rationale: For \(N=pq\ge2m+2\) the exponential window ambiguity is nowhere zero inside the short lag band, so its STFT retrieves products exactly for near neighbours. The support graph criterion includes all comparison signals and requires two separating gaps. Periodicity makes repeated time holes and Fourier support \(q\)-spaced. Two long Fourier gaps omit at least \(\lfloor m/q\rfloor\) sublattice indices each. Tao additive uncertainty \(p+1\le |S|+|T|\) gives necessity of \(m+2\lfloor m/q\rfloor\le p-1\) for joint failure. A degree-\(2h\) polynomial with two prescribed \(h\)-long root blocks gives exact joint-failure witnesses for every feasible m; all q characters follow by modulation. Boundary \(h=0\) and \(p=3\) are included. The checker validates representative finite cases, not the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The exact threshold resolves a complete, natural symmetry-restricted reconstruction question across every odd prime cell length and repetition factor, including a formula for necessary and sufficient bandwidth and explicit failures below it. The q-dependent transition quantifies when one of time-local or frequency-local full STFT magnitude arrays must recover any symmetry-eigenvector, improving the broader ambient composite sufficient criterion in a precise subclass. This is not a mere special-case restatement, numeric slice or renamed known constant.
